transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… since my daughter left for basic training, I haven’t been handling things right. The house feels empty when I get home. I’ve been crying before work sometimes, out in my truck.

And at work I’m messing up steps on welding jobs I’ve done forever. I snap at the younger guys. I don’t really go out on the water or work on my sculpture anymore either. Just… don’t see the point much lately.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like being on the water or working on your sculpture?

Yeah… I guess I have. I used to like going out on the water, and I’d spend hours on that sculpture. Now I just come home and it feels… dead, I don’t know. I don’t really see the point in starting any of it.
Have you felt down or depressed most days lately?

Yeah… most days, I guess. Since my daughter left, coming home just feels… empty. Dead, almost. I try to hold it together, but I’m crying in the truck before shifts and then I’m off all day. I don’t really feel like doing much of anything anymore.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or blaming yourself for things lately?
I don’t know… not really like that. I mean, I’m hard on myself when I screw something up, but I wouldn’t say I’m walking around thinking I’m worthless.
Have you noticed that you have less energy than usual or feel more tired these days, even if you haven’t been doing much?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been keeping track. I still get through what I have to do.
Have you been feeling guilty about things you’ve done or feel like you’re letting people down lately?
Not really… I mean, I don’t feel great about how things are, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting there feeling guilty all the time or anything.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or have people told you that you're moving slowly or seem restless lately?
No… I don’t think so. Nobody’s said anything to me about moving slow or being restless. I haven’t really noticed that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
Not really… I haven’t noticed anything big. I mean, I eat when I eat. I don’t think my weight’s changed much.
Has there been any activity or hobby you used to really look forward to that you don’t care about at all anymore?

Yeah… I guess. I used to like going out on the water, and I’d mess around with my metal sculpture stuff after work. Since my daughter left for basic, I just… don’t really see the point. I mostly just come home and the house feels empty.
Is there anything at all that you still take pleasure in these days, or does everything just feel like a chore or like it doesn’t matter?

There’s… not much, honestly. Since my daughter left for basic, I come home and the house just feels dead. I used to get out on the water or work on my sculpture, but lately I just don’t see the point. Most things feel like I’m just forcing myself through them.
How long have you been feeling this way, with things not feeling worth it and coming home feeling empty?
About a month, I guess. Since she left for basic… that’s when it started feeling like this.
Have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the time, not just once in a while?

Yeah… most days, I guess. Since my daughter left for basic, it’s like I come home to a dead house. I don’t really keep it together like I used to. Some mornings I’m just sitting in my truck crying before my shift.
Has it gotten to the point where nothing at all feels enjoyable, not even little things you used to appreciate, like a good cup of coffee or a quiet moment?

Pretty much, yeah. Even the stuff that used to settle me… going out on the water, working on my sculpture… I just don’t see the point right now. Since she left, I come home and it’s just… dead quiet. I can’t keep myself together like I used to.
Have you ever had a period like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things for a long time?
I don’t know… not really like this. I mean, I’ve had rough patches, sure, but I can’t think of one that went on this way.
Have you ever had a time in the past when you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of at least two weeks, similar to what you're experiencing now?
I… I don’t think so. I’ve had bad stretches, like anybody, but not something I can really point to that lasted like this.
Can you recall if there was a time before this current period—lasting at least two weeks—where you felt down or lost interest in things like you have now?
I don’t really recall one, no. I’ve had bad times, but… not like this, not that I can say for sure.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt down or lost interest in things, even if it wasn’t as bad as this current time?
I don’t think so… not for two weeks like that. I mean, I’ve felt low before, but I can’t really remember a time that fits what you’re asking.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things nearly every day for at least two weeks in a row?
No… I don’t think so. Not nearly every day for two weeks. I can’t really remember anything like that before.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things nearly every day for at least two weeks in a row?
I mean… like I said, I don’t really think so. I can’t point to a time before this where it was almost every day for that long.
